generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

technicalCriterionList.description: The bidder should have satisfactorily completed at least one Surveying and Geo-technical investigation work for an engineering project in the last five years, of value not less than Rs. 4.95 Lakhs (usually not less than 80 percentage of the estimated value of contract), carried out in Central Government / State Government / Semi Government / Public Sector undertakings. Certificate issued by an officer not below the rank of Executive Engineer is to be furnished.

The bidder should be an empaneled agency in KPTCL for conducting Surveying and Geo-technical investigation works under following categories for which the bidder should submit copy of the valid empanelment letter issued by the Corporate Office KPTCL.

tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Work of Tree enumeration in forest land & providing boundary demarcation using wooden sticks along the Line corridor in the forest land to the length of 5.092km in respect to the work of construction of 110kV DC line on DC towers using from existing 110/33/11kV Guruvayanakere sub-station to proposed 110/33/11kV substation at Kakkinje (Chibidre) for a distance of 21.405 kms in Belthangady taluk, Dakshina Kannada district.

itemList.description: Providing and fixing wooden sticks of 1 meter length (approx 70 mm dia) at every 20 mtr intervals at both side and centre of the line corridor

Above Sticks to be painted with yelow paint for the corridor and centre sticks to be painted with red paint above ground level of 0.7 meter Painting with synthetic enamel paint of approved brand and manufacture to give an even shade-two coats on new work after thoroughly brooming the surface to remove all dirt, dust, mortar drops and foreign matter including preparing the surface even and sand paper smooth, cost of materials, labour complete as per specifications and as per directions of Engineer-in-charge
Shifting of wooden sticks from nearest dumping place to actual location of fixing using unskilled labour ( consider UOM as Man day)

TREE SCHEDULE: Furnishing the tree schedule containing the details like name of trees, girth size, approximate height of tree etc., complete coming within the boundary of the 110KV line corridor A) Approximate Trees coming in the boundary of corridor- 2000 trees. B) Approximate Trees coming within the corridor-10000 trees Using semiskilled labour ( consider UOM as Man day)
Enamel paint (Yellow) for marking boundary of corridor on either side of the corridor (22M) on trees for 110KV line
Enamel paint (Red) for marking centre of the corridor on trees and for numbering of trees within the boundary of corridor (22M) for 110KV line corridor

Painting of one coat of yellow paint around the trees coming at the boundary of the 110KV line corridor & Painting of one coat of red paint around the trees coming at the centre of the 110KV line corridor (band of width 15-20 cm) Approximate Trees coming in the boundary of corridor- 2000 trees. Approximate Trees coming in the centre of the corridor-1000 trees. Total trees- 3000 trees Using unskilled labour ( consider UOM as Man day)

Tree numbering with red paint including chipping, cleaning the surface and clearing of small bushes Approximate Trees coming within the boundary of the corridor-12000 trees Using unskilled labour ( consider UOM as Man day)

Providing GPS Co-ordinates on each boundary wooden sticks using DGPS and to provide DGPS points in convertible pdf to excel form as per SOP and to provide componentwise KML file and componentwise corner GPS readings
